name: fx_translation_stress_inverse_quote_hedged_subsidiary
question_template: A US parent owns a euro-area subsidiary. Opening equity (a stock) is {E0} EUR million. Each quarter the subsidiary retains its full profit: {P} EUR million in Q1, changing by {G} EUR million each later quarter (negative means falling), for four quarters. At year end, before stress, a dividend of {DIV} EUR million is paid, leaving closing equity. Spot is quoted as euros per US dollar: {R0} EUR per USD. The stress is applied once, at year end after the dividend: the euro depreciates by {D} percent, meaning the USD value of one euro falls by {D} percent (so the EUR-per-USD quote rises). Translate closing equity (not opening) into USD millions at the pre-stress and stressed rates; gross translation loss is pre-stress USD value minus stressed USD value. The parent holds a net investment hedge with notional equal to {H} percent of opening equity (not closing); its USD gain is that notional translated at the pre-stress rate minus the same notional at the stressed rate. Report the net translation loss in USD millions, defined as gross loss minus hedge gain, signed: positive is a net loss, negative a net gain. Use exact arithmetic with no intermediate rounding.

slots.description: Stressed spot quote in euros per US dollar after the euro depreciation
Closing equity after retained profits and dividend, translated at pre-stress rate
Closing equity translated at the stressed rate, USD millions
Gross translation loss before hedge, positive magnitude in USD millions

program:
def solve():
    E0 = Q(P["E0"])
    p = Q(P["P"])
    g = Q(P["G"])
    div = Q(P["DIV"])
    r0 = Q(P["R0"])
    d = Q(P["D"])
    h = Q(P["H"])
    eq = E0
    profit = p
    for q in range(4):
        eq = eq + profit
        profit = profit + g
    eq = eq - div
    if eq <= 0:
        raise ValueError("closing equity must be positive")
    if d >= 100:
        raise ValueError("depreciation must be below 100 percent")
    r1 = r0 / (1 - d / 100)
    before = eq / r0
    after = eq / r1
    gross = before - after
    notional = E0 * h / 100
    hedge_gain = notional / r0 - notional / r1
    net = gross - hedge_gain
    return {
        "final": net,
        "stressed_rate_eur_per_usd": r1,
        "equity_before_usd_million": before,
        "equity_after_usd_million": after,
        "gross_loss_usd_million": gross,
    }
